messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning to enable model `redwood-llm-v2.1` in the catalog tomorrow during the 00:00-02:00 UTC change window. Primary rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 6 hours, with auto-fallback to pinned variant on errors. Please call out any blockers by EOD.
vikram: Can we pin fallback ordering explicitly? Last rollout had surprising reroute to a much smaller model. Suggest fallback: [redwood-llm-v1.9, redwood-llm-compat-lite]
sam: +1 on explicit pin. Also recommend a short canary (2hrs at 5%) with synthetic evals and p50/p95 latency checks. I'll add eval sets.
elena: Add rollback criteria: quality drop >4% on eval set OR latency increase >25% sustained for 15min. If either triggers, rollback to v1.9 and notify @eng-oncall.
maya: noted. I'll author the rollout PR and include those alarm thresholds in the release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job created by maya — model-catalog.rollout v2.1 canary @ 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z UTC (5% traffic). See /deploys/1768234567
vikram: small nit — quantization profile needs bump for v2.1 (use q8b4-recommended). If we don't, memory OOM risk on smaller instances.
sam: added metrics dashboard: catalog/model=v2.1 (latency, mem, token-cost, eval-quality). Alert rules set: latency_p95 > configured_slo*1.25, eval_quality_drop >= 4% over baseline.
elena: also ensure fallback ordering is stored in catalog metadata so routing honors it. Example metadata snippet:
```
"fallback_order": ["redwood-llm-v1.9", "redwood-llm-compat-lite"]
"pin_version": "v2.1"
"auto_rollback": true
```
maya: will include that in the PR. One more: change window reminder to support — @elena can you be on-call for the first two hours?
elena: I can for the first hour, @vikram can you cover the second hour?
vikram: yep, I'll take hour two. I'll also be ready to run manual rollback if auto-rollback misfires.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: canary started: v2.1 -> 5% at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z (actor: deploy-bot)
sam: first 10min looks clean. p50 unchanged, p95 +5% but within threshold.
maya: tagging release notes draft in the PR: "Enable redwood-llm-v2.1: improved generation quality and lower cost per token; defaults to v2.1 with v1.9 as fallback. Auto-rollback thresholds added." Will publish after full rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout completed: v2.1 at 25% (2026-04-02T02:15:00Z)
sam: evaluation check at 25% shows +3.2% quality and p95 +7% latency. Within acceptable limits.
elena: Monitoring will be active for 24h. If anything crosses the thresholds we discussed we roll back immediately.
maya: final note — pinned fallback ordering in catalog metadata and added canary + rollback controls. Closing this thread after the 24h post-rollout window unless issues arise. :thumbsup:
vikram: ack. Good job team.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: 24h watch started for v2.1 at 2026-04-02T02:30:00Z, watch ends 2026-04-03T02:30:00Z
